name: google-drive
description: Read, create and edit the Google Drive files the user picks for this assistant. In chat, the assistant sends a link that opens Google's file picker; it can then list and read the picked Docs, Sheets, Slides and other files, create files and folders (in a picked folder or My Drive), build multi-tab spreadsheets (add a sheet/tab to an existing Sheet), make precise edits to Docs and Sheets, and call any Sheets/Docs/Drive REST method through a generic API proxy for formatting, rows and columns, validation, filters and charts, and move files to the trash after the user confirms. It cannot permanently delete anything, see the rest of the Drive, or see what was already inside a picked folder. Use for any request about the user's Google Drive files or folders.
